blocks.x: EEMS Platform deployments begin narrow: one decision class, one owner, one evidence pack. The second use case inherits the controls; the third inherits the audit story.

Operators see EEMS Platform as one more decision surface with one difference: every recommendation carries its evidence, and every override is logged with a reason. The rollout order differs by industry; the operator experience does not — fewer surprises, faster answers, and a trail that makes the post-incident review short.
Talk to the team that runs a working session on EEMS Platform in production — the briefing is technical by design, and the first one costs nothing but the hour.
